lines.en:
Don't you guys have anything better to do?
Where'd ya get that uniform?  You been stealin' from the armory, street urchin?
What should we do with the thief?
Probably gonna go cryin' to the Master Sergeant again.
I'm watchin' you, street urchin!  If I had my way, kids like you'd be sent home.
Yeah, go home.  I hear the back alleys are comfy this time of year.
Heh heh heh...
You okay, Protagonist?
Hi, Zelos...  I guess so.
Don't sweat those guys.  I've seen you in class. Not enough brains between the three of 'em combined to make one of you.
Thanks...   Zelos, these are supposed to be my comrades...
They are. When it comes down to it we're all gonna bleed for each other.  They're testing you.  You gotta fight back, Protagonist.  Doesn't matter who, you always gotta show the world you're not to be messed with.
You could take these guys no problem.
If I helped you they'd never leave you alone!  Just trust me on this one.  Even if you get roughed up, it'll pay off in the end.
Something might happen to those guys later.  If anyone asks, you had nothin' to do with it.  See ya around, Protagonist.
